title: CarrierCancellationNotDelivered
description: The Carrier cancellation Logic App's message for a Cancelled or Withdrawn Carrier booking never reached the Carrier (Canonical Model event, version 1). The TMS flagged the Carrier booking Carrier not told; the Planner phones the Carrier and nothing is retried. Published on the Shipment events topic, under the correlation ID of the cancellation or withdrawal the report continues.

correlationId.description: The cancellation's or withdrawal's own correlation ID, which the report continues.

carrierBookingNumber.description: The Carrier booking whose cancellation or withdrawal the Carrier wasn't told of.

shipmentNumber.description: The Shipment the Carrier booking covers.

carrierId.description: The Carrier the message was addressed to.

kind.description: How Norvia ended the Carrier booking: withdrawn by the Planner before the Carrier answered (P4), or cancelled after it confirmed (P7).

statusCode.description: The Carrier endpoint's HTTP status code, or the technical failure's own code.

message.description: The technical cause in plain language.
